graders.expects: at least one compaction_completed event exists in the run's session

notes: Unexecuted: P1 has no runner, and the case needs a driven multi-turn loop rather than a single prompt. If no compaction occurs the case is inconclusive, not passed: the trial did not exercise the capability.
